SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2, Special Branch Station:
REPORT
File No.
S. B. REG. DAY.
917
Date June 9, 1937

Subject (in full) Periodical Service Corporation advertising for salesgirls.

Made by D.S.I. Duncan Forwarded by

The local branch of the Periodical Service Corporation,
Minneapolis, Minnesota, U.S.A., was established in Shanghai by
a German named Karl August Maier, aged 25, who arrived here
from Manila via Hongkong by the S.S. "Fulda" on March 17, 1934.
He resides in a boarding house at 106 Peking Road from where he
conducts his business. When interviewing prospective salesgirls
Maier points out that he prefers girls who have regular employ-
ment elsewhere as the commission allowed on the sale of the
periodicals is too small to be considered as a living wage.
So far he has engaged some 10 Chinese salesgirls on a commission
basis only. The commission allowed is shown in red figures on
the attached card.
As far as can be ascertained Maier's business is a genuine
one but in regard to his advertisement for two attractive sales-
girls on a salary and commission basis it is believed that his
motive was not entirely a business one, in fact to one girl who
applied for work, he openly hinted that it might be possible to
combine pleasure with business.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
档案编号
S. B. REG. DAY.
917
日期 1937年6月9日

事由（全称）《期刊服务公司》招聘女售货员广告事宜。

制作：特务科督察邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan） 转呈：

美国明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯市《期刊服务公司》（Periodical Service Corporation）上海本地分公司由一名名为卡尔·奥古斯特·迈尔（Karl August Maier）的德国人设立，时年25岁。他于1934年3月17日乘“富尔达”号轮船（S.S. "Fulda"）经香港从马尼拉抵达此处。他居住在北京路106号的一家寄宿公寓内，并在此经营业务。在面试 prospective salesgirls（ prospective 意为“潜在的、预期的”，此处指前来应聘的女售货员）时，迈尔指出，他更倾向于聘用在其他地方有正式工作的女性，因为销售期刊所给予的佣金过低，不足以视为维持生计的工资。
截至目前，他仅以佣金制雇佣了约10名中国女售货员。允许的佣金数额以红色数字标示在附卡上。
据查，迈尔的生意确属真实合法，但就其刊登招聘两名相貌姣好的女售货员、采用薪金加佣金制的广告而言，相信其动机并非纯粹出于商业目的；事实上，他对一名求职女性公然暗示，或许可以将享乐与业务结合起来。

特务科督察

特务科主管警官
